charts.ui.recoveredHelp: Uses the saved search and filters independently of the current table view. Your CSV and table filters do not change.
charts.ui.appliedHelp: Counts and the chart include only rows matching these conditions within the chosen scope.
charts.ui.countHelp: Categories bring together rows with the same text. The count shows how many rows are in each group.
charts.ui.measureHelp: Choose values to summarize. To add or average them, choose numbers; keep identifiers as names or codes.
charts.ui.histogramHelp: Choose numbers: the horizontal axis shows bins and the vertical axis counts rows in each bin.
charts.ui.heatmapHelp: Choose two categories: each cell counts rows with that combination.
charts.ui.compareHelp: Choose columns to compare. Numbers use a decimal point.
charts.ui.savedHelp: Uses recovered table filters, not the table’s current search or filters.
charts.ui.filteredHelp: Uses the current table search and filters across all matching rows, not just the visible page. Set the chart order here.
charts.ui.sampleHelp: Analyzes the whole file from disk; the table remains a read-only sample.
charts.ui.allHelp: Includes all rows and unsaved changes, even when table filters are active.
charts.ui.unavailable: The filtered view is not ready. Wait for valid filters to apply. Samples allow only whole-document analysis.
charts.ui.numberHelp: Explicit number interpretation uses a decimal point. Do not use identifiers as numbers. Invalid or unsafe values are excluded. CSV text is preserved.
charts.ui.distinctHelp: Unique values compare exact text: an empty string counts as a value and absent fields are excluded. Codes are not converted to numbers.
charts.ui.seriesHelp: One color per category, up to 8 series. Hiding a color does not filter data or recalculate totals. Absent and empty fields stay distinct; unobserved combinations are not filled with zeros.
charts.ui.lineHelp: Lines are ordered by numeric X, then source row for ties. Dates are not inferred. Empty or invalid Y values leave gaps; invalid X values are excluded.
charts.ui.boxHelp: Interpolated quartiles (Hyndman–Fan type 7), whiskers to observations within 1.5 × IQR. All outliers are counted; the first 20 per category are drawn in numeric order.
charts.ui.heatHelp: Counts exact category pairs. A position without a cell means no observations, not an imputed zero.
charts.ui.binsHelp: Equal-width bins [from, to), including the maximum in the last bin. A constant column uses one bin.
charts.ui.empty: No rows in the chosen scope.
charts.ui.exportHelp: Queries the chosen source and filters again, including unsaved changes in this revision. Exports up to 10,000 items even if fewer are drawn. Partial results are labeled. Includes all series, including hidden ones; does not export or modify the original CSV.
charts.ui.protectHelp: CSV and its .contexto.json file require new names. Protection adds an apostrophe to possible formulas only in the exported CSV; JSON preserves exact values and distinguishes null from empty. Both files are saved together. Existing files are never overwritten.
charts.ui.sampleExport: The table remains a read-only sample. Image buttons export a chart snapshot. Results query the whole source from disk within analysis limits; saving or exporting the sample as the original CSV is not enabled.
charts.ui.precisionHelp: Analysis limits: 256 MiB per source, two million rows, 200 columns and eight million cells. Approximate numbers with a decimal point; empty, invalid and values above 9,007,199,254,740,991 are excluded. Categories remain exact text; long labels are visually shortened. Do not convert identifiers to numbers. CSV content is preserved. Changing data or options invalidates results.
